name: heavy_plate_drag_undertravel
hypothesis: Doubling plate mass increases counter friction without increasing the commanded 8 N finger pressure. If the finger loses traction during the drag, its commanded travel overstates plate displacement and leaves insufficient overhang.
expected_failure: Step 5a fails the 25 mm minimum overhang check because the finger travels farther than the plate.
real_world_story: A heavy handmade stoneware plate replaces the lightweight everyday plate.
